notes: The music video plays the whole video now instead of starting wherever the song had got to: a film entered three minutes into a song used to open three minutes in and play only its last minute.

The second you stop a video on is remembered for that song, so closing the tab and entering the same video again carries on from where you stopped - and it is written down while the film plays, so a tab the phone closes later resumes too.

Pausing the video is a pause that stays: nothing puts it back on by itself - not the song underneath it, not coming back to the app - and the clock is the film’s own length, from its first frame to its last.
